description:
Casting time: 10 minutes. Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

You can see and hear a particular creature you choose, regardless of their and your location. Roll Awareness vs Awareness against the creature. If you have heard of but have never seen the creature, your roll is ill-favored. If you have seen and spoken to the creature, your roll is favored. The creature senses your presence in this moment, and may choose to lose the check voluntarily if it wants to be observed.

On a win, the spell creates an invisible, magical sensor within short range of the creature. You can see and hear through the sensor as if you were there. The sensor moves with the creature, remaining within short range of it. A creature that can see invisible objects sees the sensor as a luminous orb about the size of your fist.

On a loss, no effect, and you can’t use this spell against the same creature again for 1 day.

Instead of targeting a creature, you can choose a location you have seen before as the target of this spell. When you do, the sensor appears at that location and doesn’t move.
name: Scrying
